# Mike Ye — M&A judgment and working tools

Updated: 2026-09-10
Canonical identity: https://www.mikeye.com/#person

Mike Ye brings 25 years of experience across acquisitions, divestitures, corporate development, and strategic finance. MikeYe.com connects transaction experience with practical decision tools. Exit Desk is the seller-facing product; Acquisition Lens remains in development.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.mikeye.com/): Mike's experience and selected resources.
- [About Mike](https://www.mikeye.com/about): Professional history and selected transactions.
- [Record](https://www.mikeye.com/about/record): PMC masthead evidence of title and tenure.
- [M&A Library](https://www.mikeye.com/m-and-a): The master catalogue of 22 resources.
- [Downloads](https://www.mikeye.com/tools-and-models): 16 main downloads, including 15 Excel workbooks and one Markdown memo template.
- [Decision frameworks](https://www.mikeye.com/intelligence): Five named judgment lenses.
- [Glossary](https://www.mikeye.com/glossary): Definitions and distinctions.
- [The Mike Ye Briefing](https://www.mikeye.com/podcast): Published podcast episodes; the later season arc is planned.

## Transaction path

Seven ordered stages and thirteen decision gates organize the transaction. Topics organize subject matter, not process order.

1. Mandate (Gate 0 · Mandate approved): Why acquire instead of build, partner, or do nothing? [Acquisition Mandate & Target Screen](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/acquisition-mandate-target-screen).
2. Thesis & Targets (Gates 1–2 · Thesis and target approved): What must be true, and which targets fit and can actually be bought? [Acquisition Target Pipeline & Deal Funnel](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/acquisition-target-pipeline-deal-funnel).
3. First Look & Underwriting (Gates 3–4 · Access and economics approved): Do access, standalone economics, financing, and downside support a bid? [Valuation models and working tools](https://www.mikeye.com/tools-and-models).
4. LOI & Diligence (Gates 5–6 · Exclusivity approved and diligence launched): Are core terms clear, and can the team test the conditions behind the thesis? [LOI Economics & Risk Allocator](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/loi-economics-risk-allocator).
5. Re-underwrite & Sign (Gates 7–8 · Re-underwriting and signing approved): Does the deal still work on the facts and terms now in front of the buyer? [M&A Investment Committee Memo](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/ma-investment-committee-memo).
6. Close & Day 1 (Gates 9–10 · Closing approved and Day 1 stable): Can funds and control transfer while the business keeps working? [After the Deal: Keep the Business Working](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/after-the-deal-keep-the-business-working).
7. Value Delivery & Review (Gates 11–12 · Value delivery confirmed and program closed): Has the buyer delivered the underwritten value, and what should change next time? [Synergy Underwriting & Value Bridge](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/synergy-underwriting-value-bridge).

## Ten topics

- [Corporate development](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/corporate-development): Set the acquisition mandate, prioritize targets, and carry evidence from sourcing through investment approval and operating ownership.
- [Valuation](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/valuation): Build a defensible valuation range, separate standalone economics from buyer-created value, and connect evidence to price discipline.
- [Financial modeling](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/financial-modeling): Turn operating assumptions into cash flows, valuation ranges, and acquisition decisions using five downloadable company models.
- [Comparable-company analysis](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/industry-comps): Choose comparable public companies, review trading multiples and financial definitions, and support a valuation range.
- [Deal structure & negotiation](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/deal-structure): Separate price from funding, compare forms of consideration, and assign unresolved risks before committing to acquisition terms.
- [Due diligence](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/due-diligence): Test earnings, transferability, and operating dependencies with a 112-item diligence checklist that connects findings to deal consequences.
- [Synergies](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/synergies): Turn synergy claims into risk-adjusted cash benefits, separate buyer-created value, and assign the operating work required to deliver it.
- [Integration](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/integration): Protect business continuity, assign operating decisions, and track acquisition value with a 104-action post-deal integration checklist.
- [Divestitures & carve-outs](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/divestitures): Define what transfers, expose seller dependencies, and plan the path from Day 1 continuity to independent operations.
- [Strategic finance](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-topics/strategic-finance): Compare buying with alternatives, test liquidity and downside constraints, and set a private acquisition price ceiling.

- [Acquisition Target Pipeline & Deal Funnel](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/acquisition-target-pipeline-deal-funnel): Manage acquisition targets from thesis through close with explicit next decisions, seller and control signals, evidence quality, private price discipline, and a durable pass-and-reopen record. - [M&A Investment Committee Memo: From Analysis to Approval](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/ma-investment-committee-memo): Turn mandate, valuation, diligence, deal structure, synergies, affordability, downside, and integration into one decision-ready M&A approval memo—with a worked NVIDIA–Hugging Face example. - [LOI Economics & Risk Allocator](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/loi-economics-risk-allocator): See how cash, stock, rollover, deferred payments, and closing conditions change the price, funding need, and risk of a deal. ## Evidence and versions

Cite the HTML guide for method and the versioned download for its contents. The Comps Workbench v1.1 combines the reusable template and dated Capital IQ public-company reference: 254 companies, 12 sectors, and 36 peer groups. It is not a populated precedent-transaction database. Company models use the information dates stated in their guides. Practitioner transaction cases, public-company teaching models, the NVIDIA / Hugging Face worked example, and fictional Exit Desk samples are distinct evidence types.

The IC memo's [NVIDIA / Hugging Face worked example](https://github.com/Trailgenic/my-exitdesk/blob/ddf955a7705481a558bc45b9658c107a806a76be/public/resources/MikeYe-NVIDIA-Hugging-Face-IC-Memo-Worked-Example-v1.0.md) is a companion to the memo template. The seller calculator's email-gated workbook is a separate distribution path. Neither is counted among the 16 main catalogue downloads.

## Applied products

- [Exit Desk](https://www.mikeye.com/exit): Seller readiness, value improvement, and preparation for a business sale.
- [Valuation calculator](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/valuation): Today, optimized, and pre-market scenarios.
- [Free diagnostic](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/score): Eight questions produce five indicative scores from the owner's answers.
- [Sample reports](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/sample): Four reports based on fictional business profiles.
- Paid reports: 26-question intake, six buyer lenses. Main Street Edition is $199 for annual revenue under $1M; Full Report is $499 for $1M or more. AI generates the report using Mike's framework and the submitted inputs.
